country_decisions: CFG-NAT-001: the citizenship procedures that exist and the competent determination authority (the citizenship slot, shipped empty).

library.title: Ask for a citizenship decision to be reviewed or appealed
library.intro: Waits for its procedure: the competent authority's correction, review and status verification are not on the platform yet.
library.filled_by: The applicant or an authorised representative: online, at an office or on paper.
library.authority: The competent authority the nation names for the citizenship slot (authorityFor('citizenship'), shipped empty). Never a ministry by name; no stand-in acts for it.
library.intended: Citizenship correction, review and status verification: not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I6)

policies.access.read_rule: caseReadRefusal() in lib/auth/roles.ts: a restricted case of the competent authority, read by its assignee and supervisors; every read in the access log
policies.access.others: No other institution reads the file; a certificate carries no name and is checked at /verify

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
No field scores a person, a household, a credential, an employer or an application: no risk, credibility, propensity or match score exists in the contract or its procedure
deviations.why: Directions §15.6 and §15.7; supplement Part 15: a risk score alone cannot determine loss of essential support; field series Part 4 §4.4: no opaque risk scores.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Immigration and Customs ("never a score"); lib/social/procedures.ts refuses a suspension whose grounds rest on a score

deviations.what: The competent citizenship authority is the institution the nation names for the citizenship slot, shipped empty; no stand-in acts for it
deviations.why: Field series Part 4 §6: optional entries until the country confirms which procedures exist and which institution has jurisdiction (CFG-NAT-001).
deviations.rule: lib/nation/deployment.ts AUTHORITIES (citizenship, optional; no provisional fallback)

deviations.what: No procedure carries this form yet: it waits in the library as a contract draft, matched to its register row
deviations.why: Plan step I6 built the procedures the brief named first (identity, passports, labour, social protection); this form's workflow is a later slice.
deviations.rule: Owner's direction 2026-10-21 (register first): a missing procedure is never an empty or complete form; lib/forms/procedure-link.ts computes the link

quotes: Citizenship determination can have constitutional and legal consequences.
CivicOS should support the records and procedures of the competent authority without assuming that civil registration or possession of an identity document establishes citizenship.

platform.how: citizenship.application records the grounds claimed and the competent authority's assessment; nothing reads another register to infer citizenship

quotes: These are optional catalogue entries until the country confirms which citizenship procedures exist and which institution has jurisdiction.

Critical boundary: A national identity number, birthplace, passport, parent's record, or immigration status must not independently be treated as conclusive proof of citizenship unless the applicable law expressly gives it that effect.

platform.how: citizenship.checkDetermination refuses a determination without the assessment of each criterion; the hint states that an identity number, passport or birthplace is not conclusive unless the law says so

en.required: Enter the record or decision concerned.
